entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: There's something I want[n]to talk to you about...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'd like to meet up if possible.[n]Are you busy today?
entries.uk: Якщо можна, давай зустрінемося.[n]Ти сьогодні зайнятий?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'll be wandering around the[n]underground mall in Shibuya.
entries.uk: Я гулятиму підземним[n]торговим центром у Сібуї.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'd be happy if you could come.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You haven't talked to either of them yet.[n]Do you still want to go out and meet with[n]Lady Ann?
